nodes.name: ISM Code
nodes.safe_wording: Operational compliance with ISM Code, IMO, SOLAS, MARPOL and NORMAM-12 in marine project operations.

nodes.name: IMO / SOLAS / MARPOL
nodes.safe_wording: Operational application of SOLAS/MARPOL requirements (waste management, safety, emergency preparedness).

nodes.name: NORMAM-12
nodes.safe_wording: Operational compliance with NORMAM-12 in port/dredging operations.

nodes.name: ISO 9001 / ISO 9000
nodes.safe_wording: Supported management-system readiness, process mapping, procedure development, document control and audit preparation (C-Tank).

nodes.name: ISO 14001 / ISO 45001
nodes.safe_wording: Familiarity through HSEQ practice (Occupational Safety Engineering postgraduate); no formal management-system experience.

nodes.name: Formal internal audit
nodes.safe_wording: Inspections, non-conformity follow-up and audit-preparation evidence; not a formal internal auditor.

nodes.name: SGSO / SGIP / SGSS / ANP regulation
nodes.safe_wording: Base in ISM/IMO/SOLAS/MARPOL/NORMAM and offshore QHSE; ANP SGSO/SGIP/SGSS not directly operated.
do_not_claim: domain of SGSO/SGIP/SGSS/ANP without direct role

nodes.name: PDCA / MASP / SDCA
nodes.safe_wording: Corrective-action and continuous-improvement cycles applied to deviations and standardization (not branded MASP/SDCA programs).

nodes.name: PMI / PMBOK
nodes.safe_wording: MBA Project Management (USP/ESALQ, 400h, PMI/PMBOK) applied in Van Oord projects and Dismantle.

nodes.name: NR-17 / NR-30 / NR-33 / NR-34 / NR-35
nodes.safe_wording: Training completed; check validity dates before stating as current.

nodes.name: Class / statutory / CMMS / reliability (RBI-RCM-CBM)
